rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: QC Validator performs runtime quality validation of AI agent outputs including hallucination detection, scope compliance checks, and output completeness verification. It acts as a quality gate in agent pipelines to catch errors before they reach downstream systems or end users. The server installs as an npm package alongside other MCP tools.
